name: Cenarion Enclave
summary: In Darnassus, the Cenarion Circle gathers beneath Fandral Staghelm's leadership of the night elven druids. The Cenarion Enclave is their meeting place and seat of power, set among the capital's great hollows and living boughs.

sections.title: Heart of the Circle
sections.body:
High above the Temple Gardens, the Cenarion Enclave brings the Cenarion Circle together beneath ancient oaks and ashes whose bark bears runes. Its halls are shaped from living wood and stone. With Malfurion Stormrage absent in the Emerald Dream, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm oversees the Circle's affairs here. His ambitious vision for Teldrassil meets political friction with High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind.

Druids meditate beside the streams, and the capital's hunters gather here as well. At the stables, skilled riders learn to tame Darnassian nightsabers.

sections.title: Shadows in the Boughs
sections.body: Known as a tranquil sanctuary, the Cenarion Enclave also shelters quiet work beneath its westernmost bough. Under the hollowed roots lies a refuge where Darnassus's clandestine rogues work, shielded by the canopy above.

faq.answer: Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the grove and the night elven druids who live in Darnassus. Malfurion Stormrage, supreme leader of the Cenarion Circle, remains trapped in a deep, unexplained slumber within the Emerald Dream. Staghelm is left as the Circle's de facto authority.

Druid trainers teach among the living trees at the Cenarion Enclave, the chief home of Darnassus's druids. Hunter trainers work in the eastern boughs, while rogue trainers keep a quiet den in the root warrens beneath the western bough.

faq.q: Where can I buy a nightsaber mount?
faq.answer: Riding trainers and breeders tend Darnassus's saber cats at the base of the eastern tree, near the grove's entrance. They offer riding training and nightsaber mounts to eligible Alliance travelers.

faq.q: What is the Cenarion Circle's stance toward the Alliance?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle guards the natural order rather than fighting factional wars, though its enclave lies in an Alliance capital. Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads the enclave and is staunchly nationalist, aligning it strongly with night elven regional interests.

angles.text: As a night elf druid, you find your order's civil center here on Teldrassil. Training and guidance come under Archdruid Fandral Staghelm's stern direction.
As a hunter, you hone your marksmanship and wilderness lore in the enclave's eastern boughs. Beastmasters there rear Darnassus's nightsabers.
